risks.proof: Close-up photos of the crankshaft and alternator, ideally with labels or part numbers visible.
risks.if_unproven: priced as having potential mechanical failure

risks.risk: The generator may have hidden damage or wear not visible in the photos, such as internal engine wear, fuel system issues, or electrical faults.
risks.proof: A full inspection video or photos of the fuel system, battery, control panel, and exhaust system.

proof_requests: Video of the generator starting and running with load, showing output voltage.
Close-up photos of the crankshaft and alternator, with labels if possible.
Photos of the control panel, fuel tank, and exhaust system.
Proof of maintenance or service history, if available.
